title: ID0367755 - DC/Si-D/FI - [MP / R6 170002023] - Display sealing missing
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Display sealing missing
Root cause: HMI sealing missing
Solution: HMI sealing installed in the chargers.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:
Dear support,
Three chargers with replaced display has no sealings. The sealing was not installed due to not being included with the display and the lack of instructions. The sealing was not included in the packaging and the RC's were not informed that the sealing needs to be ordered separately. Also no instructions of the need for the sealing was included with the display packaging.
Affected chargers:
MP / R6 170002023 (Kittilä) -
MP / P7 170000667 (Sodankylä) - Done
ID0367724
MP / P8 170000820 (Kouvola Veturi) -
Best regards
Sakari Harjunpää

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367755 - DC/Si-D/FI - [Multiple SN] - Display sealing missing CRM:01251000809
additional_info.body:
Hi,
Sakari is on vacation.
Thank you for your answer.
I have completed advance repair training in fall 2022 and as my understanding there was not any mention about display sealing. Also, in repair instruction 8EM5907-0AA00-4AA1.01 has no mention about display sealing. There should be
clear
note
“please install display sealing when you install new display”. Also, in spare part catalogue has no note “please order also sealing when ordering display”.
And thanks for screenshot. This doesn’t provide you any information that new display doesn’t have sealing already installed. This clause is wooly. It is not clearly state that you need order and install display sealing for new display. And it is not clearly stated which sealing it getting damaged? Is it socket holder sealing? There should be mention that the sealing around the display gets damaged and please install new sealing for new display.
I find out October 2023 in Train the trainer training in Corroios, that the display sealing is missing and need to be ordered and installed separately.
Markus
